decisions:
/// The ranks' small all-gathers by RoCE writes (openRoce), when every rank brought it up
    fast: ?*roce.Gather = null,
    multi: ?Multi = null, // three ranks or more: small all-gathers on a borrowed wire, set once every rank's probe agreed
    ring: ?*roce_ring.Gather = null, // port note (af9777b49): four ranks on a switchless ring (TF_ROCE_RING=1), neighbours relaying
    p2p: ?*p2p_gather.Gather = null, // port note (af9777b49): two ranks on one host: peer stores (openP2p, TF_GLM_CE_EXCHANGE's wire)
